Figure 2: Per-layer accuracy gain from replacing per-channel goodness with BiCovG on Tiny-IN (left) and IN-100 (right). The dashed line shows a consistent deep > shallow trend; gains are most pronounced immediately after spatial downsampling (RMSPool), where BiCovG’s multi-scale partitioning captures the restructured feature layout.
